app.name: Flanr
app.tagline: Track and rate the cities you visit.

home.title: Every city you have been to, in one place
home.lead: Log your visits, rate cities on what matters to you and see your travels on a map.
home.comingSoon: The map and your statistics are on their way.

city.noRatings: No one has rated this city yet.

ownVisits.deleteFailed: The visit could not be deleted. Please try again.

undatedForm.title: Visits without a date
undatedForm.description: Set how many times you visited this city without knowing the dates.

undatedForm.ratingGoes: No visit to this city will be left, so your rating of it will be deleted too.

problem.invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1000.

lived.title: Living in {city}
lived.description: A city you live or lived in counts as visited, also without visits.
lived.currentNote: This becomes your home location. A city you marked as home before becomes a past one.
lived.dateFormat: A year, a month or a day: 2018, 2018-05 or 2018-05-10.

problem.from_in_future: The period cannot start in the future.

lived.removeWithRating: You have no visits to this city, so it will no longer be visited and your rating of it will be deleted too.

city.notRatedByYou: You have not rated this city.

ratingForm.title: Rate {city}
ratingForm.description: Rate the criteria you have an opinion on, then give the city your own rating from 1 to 10.
ratingForm.criteriaNote: Optional. Leave out what you cannot judge.

problem.subjective_required: Choose your rating of the city.
problem.not_visited: You can rate a city once you have visited or lived in it.
problem.failed: The rating could not be saved. Please try again.
problem.deleteFailed: The rating could not be deleted. Please try again.

ratingForm.deleteText: Your rating and your criteria ratings of this city will be deleted. Your visits stay.

city.noLists: Not in any of your lists.

visitForm.title: Log a visit to {city}
visitForm.description: Enter the date as precisely as you remember it.
visitForm.precision: How well do you know the date?
visitForm.beforeRegistration: This visit was before I joined Flanr on {date}
visitForm.undatedNote: Visits after you joined need a date, so that they count in your trip statistics.
visitForm.helpText: You decide. We recommend counting about 24 hours in a city as a visit, or a shorter stay in which you saw something of the city, depending on its size. A stay of several days counts each day as a separate visit.

problem.date_in_future: A visit cannot be in the future.
problem.date_required: Enter a date, or confirm that the visit was before you joined Flanr.
problem.failed: The visit could not be saved. Please try again.

signInPrompt.text: With an account you can plan cities, log your visits and rate the places you have been to. You will come back to this page.
